messages.subject: pushed lgamma fix & formatting fix
parts:
I also added a stan/math/functions/lgamma.hpp function that
calls Boost. Otherwise, on some platforms, a library
lgamma gets brought in automatically. I went through all of
our code that uses lgamma and configured it to use Boost's
lgamma by adding a "using boost::math::lgamma;" statement in
the function scope where it's being used.

I again removed all the tabs from our code base. And I changed
a bunch of the formatting in the files I saw to get rid of
super-long lines and to add spaces between logical operators.

- Bob
